council_pillars: C32-AEON simulation anchor: action-roguelite must be playable in 60s, readable at a glance.
C4-PRAXIS scope gate: 1 core loop + 1 meta loop max for prototype.
C27-CHRONICLE narrative seam: 3-beat run arc (hook -> twist -> payoff).
C23-CADENCE audio seam: 2 stems minimum (pulse + texture) even in prototype.
C10-CODEWEAVER test seam: headless balance.json + deterministic RNG seed.
project.next: Call gamedev_design_loop to lock verbs + loop, then gamedev_balance_economy.

core_loop_30s: ENTER: spawn with move readable in <2s
ACT: chain move, dash, shoot for mastery expression
RISK: escalating pressure timer / enemy density
PAYOFF: chunky feedback (hitstop 60ms, screen pulse, SFX sting)
META: run-based unlocks feeds next run (C32-AEON trajectory check)
design_loop.playtest_probe: Can a new player describe the loop after 1 run without prompting?

balance_economy.rule: Sources - sinks must stay slightly positive early, neutral at mid, sink-heavy at endgame.
balance_economy.council_note: C28-CALCULUS: growth >1.35 collapses late game; C25-PROMETHEUS: falsify with 100-run sim.

strikes: FUNERAL-TEST: first 60s with sound off + text skipped — is the game still readable?
RAGE-TEST: hold only one button for 3 min — does anything soft-lock?
build_review.ship_gate: No ship if save-loss, soft-lock, or unreadable-damage remain.
